message.content:
Here’s a quick example you can run from the command line (or adapt to your preferred language).  
Replace `key_four` with your actual API key.

```bash
curl -X POST "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/22.242.75.136/votes" \
     -H "x-apikey: key_four" \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -d '{"type":"vote","attributes":{"verdict":"malicious"}}'
```

**Python (requests) example**

```python
import requests

url = "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/22.242.75.136/votes"
headers = {
    "x-apikey": "key_four",
    "Content-Type": "application/json"
}
payload = {
    "type": "vote",
    "attributes": {
        "verdict": "malicious"
    }
}

response = requests.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers)
print(response.status_code)
print(response.json())
```

Both snippets will submit a “malicious” vote for the IP address `22.242.75.136`.
